sections.heading: Classification Recap
bullets: UN specialized agencies: WHO, UNESCO, ILO, FAO, WTO is NOT a UN specialized agency (it's a fully independent treaty organization outside the UN system) — a very common trap.
UN programmes/funds: UNDP, UNICEF, UNEP, WFP, UNHCR.
UN-related organizations (not specialized agencies): IAEA, IOM.
Groupings/forums with no charter or permanent HQ: G7, G20, BRICS, Quad, IBSA.
Bodies with a genuine Secretariat despite being informal associations: Commonwealth of Nations.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: This is the compiled reference: every headquarters city, founding year, and agency/programme/forum classification covered across the International Organizations subject.
keyFacts: WTO is NOT a UN specialized agency — it sits fully outside the UN system as an independent treaty organization.
IAEA and IOM are 'related organizations', not specialized agencies.
G7/G20/BRICS/Quad/IBSA have no charter and no permanent secretariat.
commonConfusion: Students very often assume WTO is a UN specialized agency because it 'feels' like one — it is legally independent of the UN system entirely.

highYieldFacts: WTO is outside the UN specialized-agency system entirely — an independent treaty organization.
ITU (1865) predates the UN by 80 years and is the oldest IGO in existence.
G20's 2023 New Delhi Summit (India's presidency) admitted the African Union as a permanent member.
commonTraps: Never list WTO alongside WHO/ILO/FAO as a 'UN specialized agency' in a precise classification question.
Do not confuse IMO (International Maritime Organization, London) with ICAO (aviation, Montreal) — both are transport-mode-specific UN agencies but cover different modes entirely.
mustRemember: When in doubt on classification, apply the three-question test from this subject's first topic: charter? permanent HQ+staff? UN-linked by treaty?
Headquarters-city facts are the single most repeated MCQ format across this entire subject — the master table above is the highest-yield page in this section.
possibleQuestions: Which of the following is NOT a UN specialized agency: WHO / WTO / ILO / FAO?
Arrange in chronological order of establishment: WHO, UN, ITU, WTO.
